reviewer_notes: Three models were extracted, corresponding to the three fitted BDP equations for 5 bar steam intensity of the INEOS Propylene Oxide plant: M1 (Eq. 29, load + ambient temperature, 3 basis functions), M2 (Eq. 30, after backward elimination of temperature, clustered on both factors), and M3 (Eq. 34, load only, clustered on load only). Table 2 reports two rows: '2 influence factors / 3 base functions' assigned to M1 and '1 influence factor / 2 base functions' assigned to M3 (this assignment is inferential; the row could alternatively belong to M2, since M2 and M3 both have one influence factor and two basis functions). Sector: propylene oxide is a petrochemical product, but the paper frames the case as continuous chemical production; sector_registered and refinery_or_petrochemical_case were coded as petrochemicals with 'requires inference' — reviewer should confirm eligibility. modelling_frequency coded hourly by inference; the models are actually fitted to 16 clustered percentile centres rather than to a temporal step, and n_observations=16 reflects the number of cluster representatives used for fitting, not the raw (confidential) sample count. EnPI = energy demand / amount of product in specification; denominator coded production mass by inference (ṁP is a production rate).
